## Checklist

- [ ] One feature/fix per PR, branched from `main`
- [ ] `pnpm check` / `pnpm lint:deps` / `pnpm test:coverage` pass locally (coverage must stay at 100% — see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Keymap changes regenerated the README table (`pnpm docs:keys`)
- [ ] User-facing behavior changes are reflected in README / `action.yml` docs
